title: Strategic Finance Manager
description:
Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

TransPerfect's Digital department is seeking an experienced Regional SEO Team Lead to own the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of SEO services across a key global region.

This is a senior operational leadership role responsible for the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of all SEO services (Technical & On-Page & AIO/GEO/LLM) within their assigned region (Americas & LATAM OR EMEA & APAC).

The role oversees a regional SEO team, ensuring high-quality delivery within the global SEO frameworks, driving innovation, operational efficiency, and maintaining strong commercial health across client engagements.

Reporting into the Global Director of Digital Strategy, it bridges strategic direction with regional execution ensuring SEO strategies align to global best practices while being adapted for regional needs.

Critically, the Regional SEO Team Lead holds shared responsibility for growing existing client accounts, supporting retention, and achieving defined margin targets, contributing directly to the agency’s profitability and success.

Critically, the Regional SEO Team Lead holds shared responsibility for growing existing client accounts, supporting retention, and achieving defined margin targets, contributing directly to the agency’s profitability and success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional SEO Leadership

  • Lead all SEO delivery across Technical SEO, On-Page SEO and AIO/GEO in the assigned region.

  • Ensure all SEO deliverables adhere to global frameworks, SOPs, and quality standards as defined by the Global SEO Team & Global Director of Digital Strategy.

  • Where necessary, collaborate with global/regional counterparts to create and/or maintain global SOPs, ensuring efficiency, consistency and process alignment

  • Oversee regional SEO resourcing (in-house & external), capacity planning, and project prioritization.

Financial & Commercial Accountability

  • Ensure projects/deliverables are executed according to defined metrics and remain in budget.

  • Overseeing time tracking of team members for the accuracy of project markup and provide insights/actions for replicating successes and mitigating in efficiencies

  • Drive SEO account growth within the region, identifying upsell opportunities and supporting pre-sales with scoping, quoting, and proposal support.

  • Maximize internal resource usage while smartly managing vendor outsourcing within approved guidelines for timely SLAs, project completion and revenue recognition.

Operational Management & Team Development

  • Manage and mentor SEO specialists within the region (Tech & On-Page,AIO/GEO), fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.

  • Ensure a clear training agenda and/or SMART objectives for the development of every team member

  • Ensure clear alignment between Technical SEO, On-Page SEO AIO/GEO, Content, UX/CRO, and Paid Media teams in delivering integrated SEO strategies.

  • Contribute to the evolution of regional outsourcing processes, vendor management, and quality control.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Participate in key client calls (strategy reviews, technical updates, performance reporting) as needed.

  • Support QBRs and strategic reviews alongside Client Services to ensure SEO is contributing to client success and growth.

  • Collaborate closely with the Global Director of Digital Strategy and other Regional SEO Team Leads to share learnings, drive consistency, and evolve services.

Team Integration, Collaboration & Innovation

  • Play a key role in the smooth integration of teams across Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and supporting functions within the region.

  • Drive alignment on processes, SOPs, and delivery standards — ensuring consistency with global frameworks.

  • Foster an environment of collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation.

  • Act as a champion of AI and GenAI innovation — encouraging the adoption of new tools, automation, and AI-driven processes that enhance delivery, scalability, and performance outcomes.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  • Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

 

Preferred experience:

You will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation over 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.


Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Engage in all phases of application development, with a focus on coding and debugging in alignment with security standards throughout the entire lifecycle

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code/APIs to support applications both for web and mobile

  • Capable to use version control software such as GIT

  • Knowledge of clean code practices

  • Experience debugging complex applications

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment

Senior Post Producer
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You'll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You'll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You'll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account. 

Responsibilities

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.
  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities.
  • Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working.
  • Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output.

Clients & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production.
  • Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work.
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Quality & Commercial

  • Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards.
  • Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices.
  • Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercial performance.

Requirements

  • Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social.
  • Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VFX and audio.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communicator, confident working with clients, agency partners and internal teams.
  • Experience managing international clients and senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
  • Calm, organised and solutions-focused, with the ability to stay composed under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player who leads by example and supports the development of others.
  • Passionate about craft, creativity, technology and innovation, with a strong eye for detail and efficiency.
  • Genuine interest in technology brands and the wider tech landscape.
  • Flexible and adaptable when project deadlines require occasional evening or weekend support. We value work-life balance and these instances are infrequent, with time off in lieu provided where appropriate.

#LI-LS1

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

You are the key point person for the projects you are leading and are responsible for delivering on time, on specification and on budget. 

You possess problem-solving skills, have a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. Communication

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a good understanding of marketing and production implementation processes across all key channels, including digital, video, content, social etc
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies
  • Ability to manage complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget 
  • Experience of building solid client relationships
  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic highly matrixed agency environment
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and relationships cross functionally
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done and a commitment to ensuring flawless execution and delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate with dynamic cross-functional teams to deliver on projects

About the team
Security Engineering is a team of five covering cloud security, detection, and security operations. They work directly in the Azure estate and are close to the infrastructure, not abstracted behind a policy layer. The team runs Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Defender for Cloud, and manages tooling through infrastructure-as-code. They run a quarterly penetration test programme and are continuously building out our detection and response capability. It's a small team with broad scope, which means your work is visible, your opinions are heard, and there are meaningful problems for our engineers to work on.

This is a contract role, so we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running. You'll bring immediate impact and add value from day one, working independently without a long ramp-up. Your work will be visible, and the problems you solve will matter.


Does this sound like you?
You're a senior security engineer who operates credibly across cloud security, detection tooling, and incident response, without being narrowly specialised. You own meaningful parts of the security stack, contribute hands-on to Azure cloud hardening, and show up reliably when incidents need investigating or pen test cycles need coordinating. You're energised by visible impact, your work matters, and your voice is heard.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own and operate our alerting and monitoring capability through a transition period, keeping detection and response steady.

  • Maintain and improve our Microsoft Sentinel deployment: writing and tuning detection rules, managing data connectors, and reducing alert noise.

  • Operate and optimise Defender XDR and Defender for Cloud, including policy management and posture recommendations.

  • Maintain and extend automated security checks in our delivery pipelines (shift-left).

  • Drive down time-to-fix on known vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation with engineering squads.

  • Support data-loss-prevention controls that reduce the risk of sensitive data leaving the business.

  • Support safeguards around how the business accesses and uses AI, including securing AI workloads and their data exposure.

  • Investigate suspicious activity surfaced through Sentinel and Defender: triage, escalate, or contain as appropriate.

  • Support incident response, including containment, evidence gathering, and post-incident review.

  • Contribute to detection-as-code and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Bicep) for security tooling.

  • Coordinate penetration test engagements (scope, logistics, findings review) and work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation.
     

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on SIEM experience, ideally Microsoft Sentinel; equivalent platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, QRadar) considered.

  • Practical Azure security experience across Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Azure networking, and cloud security posture management.

  • Experience writing infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep in a security engineering context.

  • Experience driving vulnerability remediation cycles with engineering squads.

  • Familiarity with data-loss-prevention controls.

  • Familiarity with AI security considerations (securing AI workloads, data exposure risks) and/or using AI tooling to augment security engineering workflows.

  • Ability to contribute to threat modelling and communicate security risk clearly to engineering and product audiences.

  • A growth mindset and genuine curiosity to keep learning.

  • SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst) certification.

  • KQL proficiency for detection rule authoring and threat hunting.

  • Experience working in a similar fintech or financial services environment
     

All are welcome:

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Head of Brand
description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

  • Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

  • Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

  • Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

  • Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

  • VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

  • Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

  • Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

  • Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

  • Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

  • Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

  • Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

  • Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

  • Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

  • Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a video team in place, and a team of interns to grow. The brand is yours to build and yours to run.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline

No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.

  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas

Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA

  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión

title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75). 

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.
  • Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes.
  • Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers.
  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
  • Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe.


Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet :

  • Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement.
  • Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.).
  • Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow.
  • Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle.
  • Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées.
  • Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP.
  • Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact.
  • Compétences en visualisation de données pour restituer vos analyses de manière claire.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), structuré(e) et avez un fort esprit d'équipe.
  • Force de proposition : vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où il reste des choses à construire.


Ce que ce stage vous apportera :

  • Une montée en compétences technique pointue en Python et SQL.
  • L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack data moderne et robuste (AWS, Redshift, Metaflow, Git, etc.).
  • Le passage de la théorie à la pratique : vous verrez votre code et vos modèles partir en production.
  • L’affinage de votre sens métier et de votre esprit critique au contact d'équipes variées (Tech, E-commerce, CRM, Marketing).

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

title: Graduate program | French market (Paris)
description:
Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale française, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en forte demande : tous les cabinets français cherchent une réponse à l'IA, et les usages ne sont pas encore stabilisés.

  • Une équipe qui se construit : vous entrez tôt et vous pesez sur la façon dont on vend.

  • Une vraie école de vente : un parcours structuré, du coaching hebdomadaire et des objectifs clairs à chaque étape.

Vos responsabilités

Pour soutenir notre croissance, nous lançons un Graduate Program – Sales conçu pour les 3 % de jeunes talents les plus ambitieux.

Ce n'est pas un poste junior classique. C'est un parcours accéléré, avec des rotations structurées et un objectif clair : faire de vous un Account Executive performant en 18 mois, avec le soutien de la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Vous passerez par quatre rôles consécutifs, chacun avec ses objectifs, son coaching et ses KPI :

3 à 6 mois – SDR (Sales Development Representative)

  • Qualifier les leads inbound.

  • Apprendre les bases de la discovery, la qualification d'opportunités et le passage de relais à l'AE.

6 mois – BDR (Business Development Representative)

  • Apprendre à générer du pipeline à partir de zéro.

  • Maîtriser la prospection, les séquences outbound, le premier contact et la prise de rendez-vous.

Le point de bascule

Après vos neuf premiers mois, en fonction de vos performances, de vos points forts et des compétences acquises, vous rejoindrez l'une des deux trajectoires suivantes :

6 mois – AE Inbound

  • Gérer les deals inbound sur notre segment juridique.

  • Mener les calls de discovery et les démos, traiter les objections et closer vos premiers clients.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les AE seniors, le Sales Coach et le Sales Director sur des deals en cours et sur la stratégie.

6 mois – AE Outbound

  • Prendre la responsabilité d'un territoire.

  • Piloter des deals outbound de bout en bout, avec plusieurs interlocuteurs et des cycles plus longs.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les scripts, les séquences et les playbooks au fil de vos apprentissages.

Tout au long du programme, vous serez formé et coaché au sein de la Lexroom Sales Academy, avec des modules structurés sur :

  • la méthodologie de vente (discovery, démo, négociation, traitement des objections) ;

  • la gestion du pipeline et du territoire ;

  • l'usage de l'IA dans la vente ;

  • la performance personnelle, le mindset et la communication.

Les meilleurs profils seront fast-trackés vers des rôles mid-market, enterprise ou managériaux.

Le profil que nous cherchons

  • Jeune diplômé (ou jusqu'à 1 an d'expérience) avec un vrai intérêt pour la vente B2B et la tech / l'IA.

  • Vous avez toujours été parmi les meilleurs dans ce que vous avez fait : études, sport, projets, travail.

  • Excellentes qualités de communication, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Français langue maternelle (ou C1+), anglais courant (B2 minimum, pour travailler avec les équipes transverses).

  • Drive et résilience : les objectifs ambitieux vous motivent et le "non" ne vous fait pas peur.

  • Vous apprenez vite, vous posez les questions qui dérangent et vous allez chercher le feedback.

  • Vous voulez des responsabilités tôt, pas une ligne "programme graduate" sur votre CV.

Ce que nous offrons

  • 45 000 55 000 € OTE, variable non plafonné et accéléré.

  • Equity : un package de stock-options.

  • 3 jours d'onboarding en présentiel à Milan, entièrement pris en charge.

  • Mutuelle d'entreprise (Alan) : prise en charge à 60 % par l'employeur.

  • Titres-restaurant (Swile) : 12 € par jour (pris en charge à 60 % par l'employeur).

  • Pass Navigo : pris en charge à 50 % par l'employeur.

  • Wellpass : abonnement sport & bien-être (cofinancé par l'employeur).

  • Programme Erasmus : 1 semaine par an, vol et logement pris en charge, pour travailler depuis nos bureaux de Madrid, Barcelone, Milan, Rome, Berlin ou Sofia.

  • Modèle hybride : entre le télétravail et notre bureau parisien.

Le process

  • Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours.

  • Entretien commercial : potentiel et sens commercial.

  • Mise en situation : approche et résilience.

  • Entretien final : valeurs et culture.

Chez Lexroom, nous sommes portés par des ambitions fortes et une exigence d'excellence. Nous construisons quelque chose de grand, et cela demande de l'engagement, du travail et une vraie envie de progresser. Si ce défi vous parle, nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - French (France) - Remote
description:
About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver

  • Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

  • Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

  • Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

  • Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

  • Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering.

  • Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities.

  • Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency.

  • Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing.

  • Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including:

    • Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization.

    • Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates).

    • Text I/O, toolchain interoperability, and safe string operations.

    • (For specific languages) Bidirectional/RTL handling, font fallbacks, and rendering/typography in UI or artifacts.

  • Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging.

title: On Holiday Support Agent
description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

title: Account Executive - French Speaking
description:

As an Account Executive, you will turn qualified product demonstrations into new, active, and transacting customers within a fast-growing global B2B marketplace. You will own the full commercial journey from discovery and demo through negotiation, contract closure, compliance, onboarding, and early customer activation. Beyond closing deals, you will be responsible for helping customers establish strong purchasing habits during their first 90 days. You will work closely with SDRs and Account Managers to ensure seamless handoffs and a strong customer experience. The role combines consultative selling, commercial negotiation, operational follow-through, and account activation.   • Run discovery-led product demonstrations that connect the marketplace's capabilities to each retailer's specific purchasing workflow, business needs, and commercial objectives.

  • Drive KYC and compliance processes through to completion, proactively following up on documentation and resolving onboarding obstacles without losing sales momentum.

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries.   • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.

Location: Lyon, France

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Profile and Qualifications

title: Solution Operations Manager, Value Realization
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 As a direct Business & Operations partner to our Solutions team, including Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers. You will work closely with Solutions leadership to build & scale the operating system that powers value realization across pre-sales and post-sales activities.

You will translate our value vision into a scalable operating model by building automations, defining processes and ways of working, standing up KPIs and reporting, operationalising our internal ROI framework, feeding the feedback loop to capitalize on our successes, and embedding reusable value frameworks into customer engagements.

This role is critical to turning our go-to-market strategy into repeatable, AI-native action, aligning delivery quality, output per FTE, and customer satisfaction to improve the efficiency and impact of our Solutions organisation and accelerate the value Mistral delivers to customers.

 

What You Will Do

 

Operating System & Automation

  • Build the secure-by-design operating system that links our tooling stack to the Solutions team’s needs, and design the internal tools & automations that raise output per FTE.

  • Streamline Deployment Strategist operations across pre-sales scoping and delivery, compounding shared knowledge, templates, and reusable IP.

  • Drive daily adoption of our AI layer throughout the Solutions team, productising internal work into reusable assets for the team.

Value Intelligence & ROI

  • Operationalise the internal ROI framework per project / use case, defining and surfacing where we build value.

  • Define the reporting layer and metric catalog (what we collect and surface) and build the dashboards that turn our data foundation into decisions and proof of value.

  • Stand up the customer satisfaction measurement system (define, collect, surface) as a core input to value realization.

Processes, Ways of Working & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Codify delivery playbooks, ways of working, and scaling programs end-to-end across the customer lifecycle

  • Partner with Revenue Growth, People Growth, RevOps, CSMs and Product & Engineering to align the operating system with company strategy and fuel the flywheel.

  • Ensure our operational processes are followed across geographies, embedding safety, security & compliance into our ways of working.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, or a chief-of-staff role within technical sales or solutions engineering.

  • Strong ability to bring structure to ambiguity and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Proven track record in optimising processes, impacting business KPIs, and aligning resources with business priorities.

  • Exceptional negotiation and diplomacy skills: ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and align competing priorities.

  • Hands-on, execution-focused mindset with a bias for action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

  • Hands-on builder of internal tools and data workflows; comfortable turning manual processes into scalable systems.

  • Strong analytical skills to design ROI and value frameworks, build reporting, and translate data into operational decisions.

  • Technical acumen and AI fluency: understanding of AI implementation, use cases, and scaling challenges.

  • Native-level fluency in English; additional European languages are a plus.
